Title: Establishes multidisciplinary personnel teams
Summary: Establishes multidisciplinary personnel teams to ensure prompt, coordinated, and confidential sharing of information among professionals for effective identification, assessment, and delivery of housing and supportive services.
LawCode: Add Art 3 Title 7-A §§115-d - 115-j, Soc Serv L
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the social services law, in relation to establishing multidisciplinary personnel teams
